petqc

Source: R/data.R
petqc.Rd

NACCADRC UDS, SCAN Imaging PET dataset. , . The data is sourced from the file(s) investigator_clariti_petqc_naccFREEZE.csv, investigator_scan_petqc_nacc72.csv.

NACCADRC UDS, SCAN Imaging PET dataset. The data is sourced from the file(s) investigator_clariti_petqc_naccFREEZE.csv, investigator_scan_petqc_nacc72.csv.

Usage

data(petqc)

data(petqc)

Format

A data frame with 7798 rows and 13 variables:

SOURCE
NACCID

Participant ID

NACCADC

ADC at which subject was seen (100 -9999)

SCAN_DATE
SCAN_TIME
RADIOTRACER
LONIUID
SCANNER_MODEL
PASS_FAIL
FAIL_REASON
FAIL_REASON_OTHER
FAIL_STATUS
FUNDING_SOURCE
